preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isspace() for c in input_string if c not in '()')
postconditions.description: The output string contains only letters and spaces from the input string, excluding characters inside parentheses.

postconditions.expression: all('(' not in return_value and ')' not in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string does not contain any parentheses.
